title: Compute brief — 8 September 2026
description: OpenAI anchors Firmus Malaysia AI Factories as Firmus contracted capacity clears 900 MW; MISO’s large-load reliability tariff lands at FERC. Silicon Tape mostly flat — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; one CoreWeave L40S spot tick.
lede: Today’s conversion lead is Southeast Asia, not the rental book. Firmus announced a multi-year deal for OpenAI to take dedicated capacity at two Malaysia AI Factory sites — pushing Firmus’ contracted portfolio above 900 MW across seven factories in Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia, with Vera Rubin NVL72 via NVIDIA DSX + HyperCube. Separately, MISO’s Aug 28 FERC filing (ER26-3650) puts Midcontinent large loads (>50 MW; computational loads ≥25 MW IT) under proposed visibility, PMU, ramp and ride-through rules with a Dec 4 effective ask. The Silicon Tape is another confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged; the only list tick is CoreWeave L40S spot $0.99→$0.98.
